entries.name: Mutilate

desc.1: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus an additional 88 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.

entries.source: server hotfix push 113483 (launch realms, 2026-11-03): Mutilate's flat bonus is 44/63/88 at levels 40/50/60; the client tooltip shows 40, this shows level 60's 88 (sim/rogue/mutilate.go)
